description: This Kotlin source file defines the NotesDbHelper class, which manages creation, upgrade, and schema definitions for a notes database stored in SQLite. It includes methods for creating tables and indexes, and handles database versioning.

classes.name: NotesDbHelper
classes.description: A helper class that manages the creation and version management of a notes SQLite database.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Creates the notes table and associated indexes in the database when the database is first created.

methods.name: onUpgrade
methods.description: Drops the existing notes table and recreates it during a database version upgrade.
